candidate: Zhang et al. 2023 closed soil-microfauna dispersal experiment

scientific_anchor.system: 10 independent rectangular mesocosms, each with 9 plant-resource nodes arranged from clustered to regular while preserving mean inter-node distance
scientific_anchor.source_process_claim: soil microfauna were introduced only into the central plant node at day 0; subsequent spread among the nine nodes within each mesocosm is the target process. Any later external inoculation or cross-mesocosm transfer stops the candidate.
scientific_anchor.time_design: day 0 inoculation followed by six destructive node-level sampling occasions at 15-day intervals through day 90
scientific_anchor.focal_response: presence/absence of plant-feeding nematodes at a node-time, derived prospectively from the published abundance measurement without changing its zero semantics
scientific_anchor.focal_response_selection_rule: plant-feeding nematodes are fixed because they are the subject of the paper's first explicit biological hypothesis and have a priori sedentary/low-mobility life-history justification; no node-by-time response table was inspected to choose the focal group
scientific_anchor.prospective_endpoint: same-learner paired heldout complementarity of frozen conventional node/time/resource features versus the identical learner/features plus frozen EOG Layer B

known_design_without_response_rows.expected_outer_units: mesocosm identity, with heldout assignment frozen before response access

response_semantics_boundary.prospective_estimability: uncertain_pre_response; exact count gate must be first outcome-dependent operation if all response-blind gates pass
